capabilities: Insert HUD widget codeblocks into notes via syntax or a command
Render vault stats, activity heatmaps, timelines, and completion trend charts
Track sessions with start and end timestamps in auto-created log notes
Add quick-action buttons that run commands, open notes, or open URLs
Update widgets directly from GitHub in plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a theme or appearance plugin; it renders interactive widget dashboards inside hud codeblocks.
extras: The plugin is read-only except the Live Session Tracker, which creates session log notes; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Widget scripts can also run standalone inside dataviewjs codeblocks without the plugin installed.
intentEvidence: you do NOT need Dataview or any other plugin installed!
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard-style widgets, and building stat panels or charts usually means pasting large DataviewJS scripts into notes.

relations.evidence: You MUST install and enable the Dataview community plugin (with "Enable JavaScript Queries" turned ON) to run them.
you can optionally select your QuickAdd start/end commands in ⚙️ Settings
You do NOT need the Banners plugin (or any other community plugin) installed to display cover images

summary: Codeblock-based sci-fi HUD widgets that render vault stats, activity heatmaps, navigation cards, session trackers, and dashboards inside notes.
